$comment: Coverage thresholds for orchestrator agents and CI. Portable across projects — adjust values per-repo.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. bin/coverage-check.sh reads the `lines` threshold from this file, runs `go test -coverprofile -covermode=atomic ./...`, and exits non-zero if total coverage is below it. If coverage drops below the threshold, the task fails.
